profile.headline: Professional Stained Glass Artist and Studio Owner

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Making and teaching stained glass art.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Designed and led a full-stack project to completion, using AWS Lambdas in Go, a websocket API, and Vue.js
- Mentored interns and junior engineers through reviewing code, providing project feedback, and problem-solving development issues
- Implemented intermediary and final-stage SQL database migrations for a crucial service redesign without service downtime
- Developed a training curriculum for engineers and analytics teams to utilize internal graph-building development tool used for underwriting logic

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Developed thread-safe, backend logic for updating data on a given loan application using Java and SQL
- Documented the business logic of a monolithic web application and provided suggestions for functional improvements that would improve run-time
- Utilized Datadog and AWS Cloudwatch to increase monitoring and alerting on critical business services, decreasing false-positive alerts by over 50%

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Teaching Assistant- Software Design and Implementation I
positions.description:
• Demonstrated understanding of C and C++ algorithms and concepts for introductory software course
• Prepared and led supplemental material review sessions for 125 second-year students
• Enabled students to learn debugging techniques to take ownership in solving unique software issues

positions.title: Teaching Assistant- Enhancing Academic Success
positions.description:
• Designed lessons about learning strategies specialized for first-year electrical engineering students
• Empowered students through being a role model of time-management skills and the growth mindset
• Mentored groups of students on topics including study skills, class schedules, and resilience to setbacks

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Redesigned loan underwriting flows with Neo4j and Cypher, improving runtime performance by 66%
• Implemented new underwriting process into backend web applications using Go
• Tested analytic model accuracy in customer credit evaluation using JSON mock files

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Designed an API for modem memory collection and compression for the 5G modem performance team
• Integrated C modules to interact with overhead heap collection in the modem crash process
• Tested and debugged modem software on target devices with embedded system analysis techniques

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description:
• Diagnosed and resolved technical issues and error complaints on Apple and iOS devices from RecSports staff
• Utilized knowledge of software and hardware systems to maximize the efficiency of department employees

company.name: University of Texas at Austin RecSports

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description: Researched high voltage power supplies and their application to the Space Science and Engineering Division, while designing and fabricating a final power supply project.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

organizations.name: Student Engineering Council
organizations.description: Restructured the method in which membership is measured and recorded, impacting over 100 students. Directed a team of 15 undergraduate students to host inclusive events for engineering students.

organizations.name: Electrical and Computer Engineering Undergraduate Advisory Board
organizations.description: Represented and worked on behalf of the students of the Cockrell School of Engineering to improve the quality and accessibility of an electrical and computer engineering education by working on campus culture, community outreach, and academic collaborations with faculty on the department degree plans.
